refactor(tui): move plan handoff popup out of chatwidget

Extract the Plan Mode implementation popup construction into a focused
`chatwidget` submodule so the large widget file stays on orchestration.

The refactor preserves the existing popup behavior while keeping the
clear-context handoff prompt and disabled-state checks close together.

head_commit.message:
fix(tui): elide plan handoff helper lifetime

Remove the explicit lifetime from the clear-context plan helper so
Clippy accepts the TUI target under the Bazel lint configuration.

The helper still returns the approved plan borrowed from the cached
plan markdown; this only lets Rust infer the same relationship.
